claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound most plausibly kills cells through a cationic amphiphilic drug-like lysosomal/phospholipidosis stress or a broad antiproliferative off-target effect rather than through DRD2 antagonism, since dopamine receptor antagonism is not cytotoxic in this screen.
